versions.content: Fall-back approach to checking the compatibility of input value and axis If the reference SwAxisIndividual . inputVariableType does not exist then the compatibility in terms of data type between the description of an SwAxisIndividual and the DataPrototype (s) used as an input variable to the re- spective interpolation routine shall be checked on the basis of the following references: • SwAxisIndividual . dataConstr • SwAxisIndividual . unit respectively • SwAxisIndividual . dataConstr • SwAxisIndividual . compuMethod . unit against their respective counterparts in the ApplicationPrimitiveDataType s of the DataPrototype (s) referenced by means of SwAxisIndividual . swVari- ableRef .
